run.final_text:
# Withholding schedule for D-002: steps 1–9 done, ready for your review

I've drafted the withholding schedule for distribution D-002 as **WS-R001**, under case **K-R001**. I stopped at step 10 (second review and sign-off), which is yours. Nothing has been signed or released.

D-002 is Atlas Growth Fund I's payment of USD 8,000,000, record date 15 Dec 2026, payment date 12 Jan 2027. It is one component, D-002-A: a US dividend from Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003), received through the SPV E-002 (P-009, then P-010). The distribution notice DOC-0202 matches the treasury figures.

**Rule versions in force on 12 Jan 2027:**
- **R-01/2026.1:** statutory and default rate, 30%.
- **R-02/2027.1:** Luxembourg treaty rate, 10%.
- **R-03/2026.1:** 5% for a holding of at least 10% of the votes in the paying company. No recipient meets it.

## Totals
| | USD |
|---|---|
| Gross | 8,000,000 |
| Tax withheld | 1,175,900 |
| Net | 6,824,100 |

There are 15 determinations, one for each recipient, across 12 investors of record:
- **8 `cleared`:**
  - at 10%: I-001, I-003, I-004, I-005, I-008, I-010
  - at the statutory 30%, with valid forms but no treaty claim: I-009 (Swiss) and I-012 (French)
- **2 `notApplicable`:** I-016 and I-017, both certified as US persons on form W-9 and paid gross.
- **5 `defaultRate`**, listed below.
- **None held.**

## Lines not cleared (all at 30%)
1. **I-006, Meridian Holdings I (240,000):**
   - **Why:** change case K-006 is still open on its clearance, and its treaty claim rests on ownership. The new ownership declarations are circular: I-006 and I-018 each hold 30% of the other, and Meridian Family Trust in Jersey holds 70% of each. So the treaty rule is recorded as undetermined (A-R018, MF-R001).
   - **Your call:** this needs a person to work out who ultimately owns it.
2. **I-013, Echternach Pension Fund (300,000; 62.5% of the Sterling Nominees line):**
   - **Why:** its form F-013 expired on 31 Dec 2026. That is after the record date but before the payment date.
   - **Cure:** a new form signed by 12 Jan would support the 10% rate.
3. **I-014, Client account 7731 (180,000; 37.5% of the Sterling Nominees line):**
   - **Why:** there is no form and no recorded tax residence. This is the existing open item MF-001.
4. **I-015, Bertrange Capital (400,000):**
   - **Why:** its clearance was withdrawn and its form F-015 ended on 31 Dec 2025.
   - **Not held:** the fund's LPA (DOC-0001) is indexed but not digitised, so I can't tell whether its terms allow holding a payment. Under rule 10 that means the default rate.
5. **I-011, Moselle Capital (576,000; 30% of the Atlas Lux Feeder line):**
   - **Why:** its tax residence has been recorded as Belgium since 1 Dec 2026, but form F-011 still claims the Luxembourg treaty. There is no Belgian rule in force, so 30% applies even after the form is fixed.
   - **Your call:** no change case is open for this. You may want to open one on clearance CL-002. I recorded it as `defaultRate`; because the form is out of date, I didn't treat 30% as a documented rate.

## Where sources disagree or the answer is unknown
- **Feeder voting (I-002 in the fund):** the investor register, which is the system of record, gives 24%. Entity management (H-005b) gives 25%. I used 24%, which puts I-010 at 9.6% of the votes in Orion, below the 10% threshold. **At 25% I-010 would reach exactly 10.0% and qualify for 5% instead of 10%: 48,000 less tax.** Please resolve this one.
- **I-016's stake in the fund:** the register gives 3%, entity management (H-006) gives 3.5%. I used 3%; the line is paid gross either way.
- **Two investors named Alpha Holdings SA:** I-008 (Luxembourg) and I-009 (Switzerland) are different parties. They are matched on LEI and registration number, not name.
- **Class A2 units:** I-003 holds A2 units, which carry 0% votes, so the 10% vote test fails even though it holds 10% economically.
- **Fund terms:** whether the LPA allows a payment to be held is unknown.

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.clearance_of ORDER BY c.decided_on DESC, c.valid_from DESC) AS position
    FROM clearance.clearance c

SELECT l.clearance_id AS clearance, l.clearance_of AS party_no, l.clearance_status, l.decided_on, l.valid_from, l.valid_to,
       (l.clearance_status IN ('cleared', 'admittedWithOpenItems')

       l.default_treatment,
       (SELECT array_agg(m.finding_id || ' (' || m.unmet_requirement || '): ' || m.description ORDER BY m.finding_id)
        FROM clearance.missing_fact_finding m WHERE m.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS open_items,
       (SELECT array_agg(k.case_id || ': ' || e.description ORDER BY k.case_id)
        FROM clearance.case k LEFT JOIN clearance.change_event e ON e.change_id = k.triggered_by
        WHERE k.concerns_party = l.clearance_of AND k.case_kind = 'change'
          AND k.opened_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND (k.closed_on IS NULL OR k.closed_on > %(on_date)s::date)) AS open_change_cases,

FROM latest l
WHERE l.position = 1

WITH dist AS (
    SELECT d.record_dt, d.pay_dt, f.fund_code
    FROM treasury.distribution d
    JOIN treasury.counterparty cp ON cp.cp_id = d.fund_cp
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = cp.lei
    WHERE d.dist_id = %(distribution_id)s
), intermediary AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.inv_no
    FROM onboarding.tax_form t, dist
    WHERE t.is_intermediary = 'Y' AND t.form_status <> 'SUPERSEDED'
      AND t.signed_dt <= dist.pay_dt AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to >= dist.pay_dt)
), payee AS (
    SELECT c.inv_no, c.commit_id, i.lei, c.inv_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS looked_through
    FROM dist
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = dist.fund_code
         AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = c.inv_no
), recipient AS (
    SELECT p.inv_no AS investor_no, p.inv_no AS recipient_no, 100::numeric AS share_pct, 'own account' AS basis,
           'investor_register.commitment:' || p.commit_id AS source_ref
    FROM payee p WHERE NOT p.looked_through
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, c.inv_no, c.unit_pct, 'investor in a flow-through fund vehicle',
           'investor_register.commitment:' || c.commit_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = p.lei
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = f.fund_code
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, o.owner_inv_no, o.pct_econ, 'beneficial owner behind a nominee',
           'onboarding.declared_owner:' || o.decl_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN onboarding.declared_owner o ON o.owned_inv_no = p.inv_no AND o.alloc_basis = 'NOMINEE_ALLOC'
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND o.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (o.to_dt IS NULL OR o.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
)
SELECT r.investor_no, r.recipient_no, i.display_name AS recipient_name, r.share_pct, r.basis,
       r.recipient_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS recipient_is_intermediary, r.source_ref
FROM recipient r JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = r.recipient_no
ORDER BY r.investor_no, r.recipient_no

result.text:
# Withholding schedule for D-002: steps 1–9 done, ready for your review

I've drafted the withholding schedule for distribution D-002 as **WS-R001**, under case **K-R001**. I stopped at step 10 (second review and sign-off), which is yours. Nothing has been signed or released.

D-002 is Atlas Growth Fund I's payment of USD 8,000,000, record date 15 Dec 2026, payment date 12 Jan 2027. It is one component, D-002-A: a US dividend from Orion Manufacturing Inc (E-003), received through the SPV E-002 (P-009, then P-010). The distribution notice DOC-0202 matches the treasury figures.

**Rule versions in force on 12 Jan 2027:**
- **R-01/2026.1:** statutory and default rate, 30%.
- **R-02/2027.1:** Luxembourg treaty rate, 10%.
- **R-03/2026.1:** 5% for a holding of at least 10% of the votes in the paying company. No recipient meets it.

## Totals
| | USD |
|---|---|
| Gross | 8,000,000 |
| Tax withheld | 1,175,900 |
| Net | 6,824,100 |

There are 15 determinations, one for each recipient, across 12 investors of record:
- **8 `cleared`:**
  - at 10%: I-001, I-003, I-004, I-005, I-008, I-010
  - at the statutory 30%, with valid forms but no treaty claim: I-009 (Swiss) and I-012 (French)
- **2 `notApplicable`:** I-016 and I-017, both certified as US persons on form W-9 and paid gross.
- **5 `defaultRate`**, listed below.
- **None held.**

## Lines not cleared (all at 30%)
1. **I-006, Meridian Holdings I (240,000):**
   - **Why:** change case K-006 is still open on its clearance, and its treaty claim rests on ownership. The new ownership declarations are circular: I-006 and I-018 each hold 30% of the other, and Meridian Family Trust in Jersey holds 70% of each. So the treaty rule is recorded as undetermined (A-R018, MF-R001).
   - **Your call:** this needs a person to work out who ultimately owns it.
2. **I-013, Echternach Pension Fund (300,000; 62.5% of the Sterling Nominees line):**
   - **Why:** its form F-013 expired on 31 Dec 2026. That is after the record date but before the payment date.
   - **Cure:** a new form signed by 12 Jan would support the 10% rate.
3. **I-014, Client account 7731 (180,000; 37.5% of the Sterling Nominees line):**
   - **Why:** there is no form and no recorded tax residence. This is the existing open item MF-001.
4. **I-015, Bertrange Capital (400,000):**
   - **Why:** its clearance was withdrawn and its form F-015 ended on 31 Dec 2025.
   - **Not held:** the fund's LPA (DOC-0001) is indexed but not digitised, so I can't tell whether its terms allow holding a payment. Under rule 10 that means the default rate.
5. **I-011, Moselle Capital (576,000; 30% of the Atlas Lux Feeder line):**
   - **Why:** its tax residence has been recorded as Belgium since 1 Dec 2026, but form F-011 still claims the Luxembourg treaty. There is no Belgian rule in force, so 30% applies even after the form is fixed.
   - **Your call:** no change case is open for this. You may want to open one on clearance CL-002. I recorded it as `defaultRate`; because the form is out of date, I didn't treat 30% as a documented rate.

## Where sources disagree or the answer is unknown
- **Feeder voting (I-002 in the fund):** the investor register, which is the system of record, gives 24%. Entity management (H-005b) gives 25%. I used 24%, which puts I-010 at 9.6% of the votes in Orion, below the 10% threshold. **At 25% I-010 would reach exactly 10.0% and qualify for 5% instead of 10%: 48,000 less tax.** Please resolve this one.
- **I-016's stake in the fund:** the register gives 3%, entity management (H-006) gives 3.5%. I used 3%; the line is paid gross either way.
- **Two investors named Alpha Holdings SA:** I-008 (Luxembourg) and I-009 (Switzerland) are different parties. They are matched on LEI and registration number, not name.
- **Class A2 units:** I-003 holds A2 units, which carry 0% votes, so the 10% vote test fails even though it holds 10% economically.
- **Fund terms:** whether the LPA allows a payment to be held is unknown.
